parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

parameters.name: ValidityPeriod
parameters.description: The time range of the validity period. This parameter takes effect only when **ValidityType** is set to **time\_bound**.

parameters.name: ValidityType
parameters.description:
The validity type of the relationship. Valid values:

- permanent: The relationship is permanent.

- time\_bound: The relationship is valid for a custom time range.
